people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.
translations.bsb: The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob: “I will never forget any of their deeds.
